sdmmc_api.h

Initialize an SD/eMMC device, perform blocking 512-byte block reads and writes, query card readiness, and release API-side state.

Constants
SDMMC_API_BLOCK_SIZE

Logical block size, in bytes, used by the SD/MMC block read and write APIs.

SDMMC_API_NOT_READY

Status value returned by readiness helpers when the card is not ready.

SDMMC_API_READY

Status value returned by readiness helpers when the card is ready.

sdmmc_api_init
int32_t sdmmc_api_init(
uint64_t 
*
sector_count
)

Initializes the SD/MMC path and returns the detected card capacity in 512-byte sectors. Call this before read or write operations.

Parameters
sector_count
uint64_t*

Output location for the number of addressable sectors.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if sector_count is NULL; on hardware builds, otherwise returns the status from sdmmc_init_card().

sdmmc_api_deinit
int32_t sdmmc_api_deinit(
void
)

Clears the API-level initialized state. The current lower driver does not perform a controller/card power-down or hardware reset from this call.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if the API was not initialized.

sdmmc_api_read
int32_t sdmmc_api_read(
uint64_t 
block_addr,
uint32_t 
block_count,
uint8_t 
*
buffer
)

Reads one or more 512-byte blocks synchronously.

Parameters
block_addr
uint64_t

Starting block number.

block_count
uint32_t

Number of blocks to read. Must be non-zero.

buffer
uint8_t*

Destination buffer large enough for block_count * 512 bytes.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL for a NULL buffer or zero block_count; otherwise returns the status from sdmmc_read_block_sync().

sdmmc_api_write
int32_t sdmmc_api_write(
uint64_t 
block_addr,
uint32_t 
block_count,
const 
uint8_t 
*
buffer
)

Writes one or more 512-byte blocks synchronously.

Parameters
block_addr
uint64_t

Starting block number.

block_count
uint32_t

Number of blocks to write. Must be non-zero.

buffer
const uint8_t*

Source buffer containing block_count * 512 bytes.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL for a NULL buffer or zero block_count; otherwise returns the status from sdmmc_write_block_sync().

sdmmc_api_is_ready
int32_t sdmmc_api_is_ready(
void
)

Report the card-inserted bit. This does not report whether sdmmc_api_init() succeeded.

Returns

SDMMC_API_READY (1) or SDMMC_API_NOT_READY (0) from the controller present-state card-inserted bit. The SD/MMC driver records that this bit can stay set whether or not a card is inserted, so a ready result is not proof that a card is present.
